notes.title: Full Development Phase Begins!
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that the full development phase of our game officially begins today! After months of concept design, prototyping, and planning, it's time to turn our dreams into reality.[/p][p]During this process, we'll regularly share progress updates with you. Every month, we'll bring you new updates, development logs, and exclusive content. Your community feedback is invaluable to us, and we want to shape this game together with you.[/p][p]Keep following us and join us on this exciting journey![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619531/bfbf54fdcf1669f85ef804101aeafaf57a05a45f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Are we on live?
notes.notes:
I think we're live. This makes me very happy because it feels great to feel like you can accomplish things.
See you soon with more developments.
